title: KK Split Crowned Croatian U17 Champions After Final Masterclass
description: ZAGREB - The Croatian U17 National Championship (Prvenstvo Hrvatske za kadete) concluded in dramatic fashion at the Dubrava sports complex in Zagreb, where KK Split put on a dominant display to defeat traditional rivals KK Cibona 88-72 in the grand finale, capturing the prestigious national youth crown. Led by a historic individual performance from tournament MVP Luka Leni UkiÄ‡, Split defied early-season expectations to cap off a remarkable run through the Jedinstvena Kadetska Liga (JKL) and the Final tournament.
